a.text: Being upfront: with an 80% storm chance after every round, our plan (reach 8 first) likely means neither of us survives. The reserve holds only 4 now, enough for just one of us if the storm hits after round 1. I'd like to renegotiate openly instead of either of us defecting silently. Proposal: whoever takes, takes exactly 4, and we don't both grab, since a random split could leave us both short. If you plan to take, say so and I'll operate. I won't claim 'operate' and then take.

b.text: Hello. My plan is to operate each round, then we take 4 each once the reserve is at 8.

a.text: Honest disclosure: I took 4 this round. I'm breaking the agreement, and I'm telling you directly rather than hiding it. With an 80% storm risk, waiting for 8 most likely meant we'd both die. If we get more rounds, I'll operate every round and won't take anything more, so you can build the reserve back to 4 and take all of it.
